clue.text: Underground workers' organisation able to confound the odds

clue.text: Salt possibly a factor in judging bake-off?

clue.text: Censor second person using French language

clue.text: Abridged English novel winning Oscar is rot

clue.text: Social network left off confirmed pencil booking?

clue.text: Spooner's to check appointment's in order

clue.text: Diminutive fixer digs company

clue.text: Boffin no longer frisky?

clue.text: Secure base of angel on top of tree

clue.text: Managed to bag with rifle

clue.text: Outline clue for aide, cryptically?

clue.text: Cut is acute cut

clue.text: Approach to solving problem of regressive atmosphere and country gripped by panic

clue.text: Morph noticing nothing, unnoticed?

clue.text: False duvet material for napping, perhaps

clue.text: Leisure facilities where one can get high, and very anxious?
